bio.text: Rick Scott was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2018, was sworn in in January 2019, and is serving his second term representing Florida.
Before the Senate he served two terms as the 45th Governor of Florida; his Senate biography says he opened a donut shop and later ran what it calls the world's largest healthcare company.
He served on active duty in the Navy as a radar man aboard the USS Glover and attended the University of Missouri, Kansas City, using the G.I. Bill.
